senses.gloss: m. (comp. of מָנוֹן a. בֵּיתָא) manager of the house, executor.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 91a:9">B. Bath. 91ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>עד דלא … קיימא מָנוֹבַיְיתֵיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>קימא מנו ב׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) before the dying man is dead, his executor stands (ready to assume the administration).
